result: 80 host service unit tests, 10 persistence-outcome tests and 5 real Chrome component lifecycle tests passed. Root source types and the 26-file public CSS audit passed separately.

scope.hostServices: SDK-free structural App/Network/Preferences and browser/mail capabilities; exact existing non-secret preference allowlist, serialized per-key reads/writes/readback, stable snapshots, refcount subscriptions and event/lifetime fences.
scope.hostMount: One canonical InterfaceLanguageProvider and PlatformServicesProvider. HostRuntimeStatus actually subscribes native state. A persistence-status controller observes only the latest attempt without owning or resetting locale.
scope.browserProbe: Real Chrome/React and mountHostApp, canonical language provider/control, HostPlatformServices and actual status CSS. App is explicitly replaced by a DOM/input/canvas-element component probe. Native plugin implementations are structural controlled doubles.
scope.backend: No SDK-backed backend, Supabase session/account, purchase provider or live endpoint behavior was exercised. Later native backend guard edits are outside this evidence.
scope.copy: New host runtime network and language-persistence notices are synchronized RU/EN AI drafts with releaseReady:false.

limits: Focused directly relevant source/config/probe inventory, not a complete transitive bundler closure or signed build receipt.
The eight owned host source/test/probe/config SHA values match the previously captured final source freeze.

vitest.config.ts is captured after root added exact tests/host/**/*.spec.mjs and dist-native/** exclusions. Targeted unit commands were explicit files and were not rerun to manufacture a full-current-config claim.
The Chrome bundle was generated in memory and not retained as a native or release artifact.

covers: No constructor/read native IO; injected native kind/channel and immutable pre-resolved language snapshot.
Duplicate callback refcounts; late handles/cleanup; pending registration independent initialization; synchronous registration events and stale read/event/lifetime fencing.
Per-key writes, readback, reads and removal ordering; cross-key independence; exact allowed values; rejection/mismatch/malformed response and missing capability handling.
Strict HTTPS and exact support mailto; default denial; current injected child-aware policy; observable awaited requested/unavailable/blocked results; rejection/error sink containment.
Old success/failure cannot erase a newer pending or failed outcome.
No locale mutation from completion; failed initial read distinguished from failed write.
Current success clears failure; disposal fences late completion; exception handling and paired draft dictionaries.

sourceNote.derivation: Reconstructed from the frozen final module by reverting only 'let status: HostLanguageStatus = initialStatus;' to 'let status = initialStatus;'. This SHA was not captured during the unit execution.
sourceNote.limitation: The ten-case run preceded the annotation-only TypeScript fix. The final annotated module was subsequently exercised by the five Chrome cases and checked by root tsc.

covers: Host mount creates two active owned native listener handles after StrictMode setup.
RU/EN/RU document lang/title and probe header reflect the one canonical provider/control.
Native network hints and persistence notices localize; no browser language-preference reads/writes occur.
Same child DOM canvas element and input selection survive locale/network/write outcomes; this is not a live R3F scene assertion.
Delayed serialized native writes cannot replace the newest pending choice; latest failure remains localized; current retry clears it.
Status fits 320px in the inspected failure flow; aria status/live/atomic attributes are asserted.
Initialization precedence uses native saved preference, then valid native language/fallback; unavailable preference is disclosed.
Unmount removes owned listeners, ignores stale events/late persistence completion, and keeps the one-mount guard.

checks.attribution: Root observed the guarded shell chain: if LASTEXITCODE was nonzero it exited; otherwise it ran build-native android dev. That session completed exit 0. This review inspected/copied the empty type log and received the exact command/chunk/guard confirmation from root.
limits: An empty log alone is not success proof.
tsconfig.json includes src; tests/host/*.test.ts execute through Vitest but are outside that root static typecheck include.
Later two-file native backend guards were tested separately and are not retroactively covered here.

priorAttempts.cause: An initial host test cleanup variable was inferred as () => undefined and could not accept () => void; explicitly annotated before the final 80-case host test/source freeze. That in-flight root typecheck also reported separate adapter test typing issues owned and fixed by their author.
let status = initialStatus inferred only idle | read-unavailable; publish also accepts saving/failed.
priorAttempts.fix: Explicit let status: HostLanguageStatus = initialStatus; runtime behavior unchanged.

priorAttempts.note: The first and only host Chrome probe run completed all five cases. Earlier S03 PWA probe setup failures belong to separate historical evidence.

logs.limits: Playwright last-run summary contains status and failed IDs only; five-case count comes from the observed list reporter output.
Zero bytes. Success is established by the observed guarded command chain, not by log emptiness.

toolchain.observedAt: evidence capture, not an independent test-run lock attestation

handoff.remainingS03: S03 acceptance remains open; its current browser/account-policy and final acceptance evidence are separate from this host preparation.
handoff.remainingS04: Root owns native artifact/build verification. This record does not establish installed-device lifecycle, actual native plugin behavior, real LiteraryGlobe instance preservation, deep-link/restart/resource behavior, iOS execution, or S04 acceptance.
handoff.ownership: The implementation preserves canonical App/provider/scene ownership. Programming, translation and remaining validation stay internal; no owner translation/programming task is transferred.
handoff.git: No Git mutation was performed. The copied known logs may require root to explicitly add ignored paths.

limitations: No current full regression is claimed: historical full4479 and prior S03 artifact/cross-engine results are not repeated or relabeled by these narrow checks.
No actual globe, Android/iOS device, native installation, release binary, store SKU, account recovery/deletion, billing, production deploy or release approval is established.
Native preference success/readback is best-effort acceptance, not fsync/durability or proof of ownership.
Network state is a device hint, not evidence of endpoint availability, authorization or a live purchase check.
